sentences.text: The Eagles are an American rock band formed in Los Angeles in 1971 by Glenn Frey , Don Henley , Bernie Leadon , and Randy Meisner .	Los Angeles	Los Angeles	Glenn Frey	Glenn Frey	Don Henley	Don Henley	Bernie Leadon	Bernie Leadon	Randy Meisner	Randy Meisner	rock	Rock music	Eagles	Eagles (album)

With five number-one singles , six Grammy Awards , five American Music Awards , and six number one albums , the Eagles were one of the most successful musical acts of the 1970s .	Eagles	Eagles (album)

At the end of the 20th century , two of their albums , Their Greatest Hits -LRB- 1971 -- 1975 -RRB- and Hotel California , were ranked among the 20 best-selling albums in the United States according to the Recording Industry Association of America .	California	California	Hotel California	Hotel California	best-selling albums in the United States	List of best-selling albums in the United States	Recording Industry Association of America	Recording Industry Association of America

Hotel California is ranked 37th in Rolling Stones list of `` The 500 Greatest Albums of All Time '' and the band was ranked number 75 on the magazine 's 2004 list of the 100 Greatest Artists of All Time .	California	California	Hotel California	Hotel California	The 500 Greatest Albums of All Time	Rolling Stone's 500 Greatest Albums of All Time

The Eagles are one of the world 's best-selling bands of all time , having sold more than 150 million records -- 100 million in the U.S. alone -- including 42 million copies of Their Greatest Hits -LRB- 1971 -- 1975 -RRB- and 32 million copies of Hotel California .	California	California	Hotel California	Hotel California	Eagles	Eagles (album)
Their Greatest Hits -LRB- 1971 -- 1975 -RRB- was the best selling album of the 20th century in the U.S. .
They are the fifth-highest-selling music act and the highest-selling American band in U.S. history .

The band released their debut album , Eagles , in 1972 , which spawned three top 40 singles : `` Take It Easy , '' `` Witchy Woman , '' and `` Peaceful Easy Feeling . ''	Eagles	Eagles (album)	top 40	top 40	Take It Easy	Take It Easy	Witchy Woman	Witchy Woman	Peaceful Easy Feeling	Peaceful Easy Feeling

Their next album , Desperado -LRB- 1973 -RRB- , was less successful than the first , only reaching number 41 on the charts ; neither of its singles reached the top 40 .	top 40	top 40	Desperado	Desperado (song)

However , the album does contain what would go on to be two of the band 's most popular tracks : `` Desperado '' and `` Tequila Sunrise . ''	Desperado	Desperado (song)	Tequila Sunrise	Tequila Sunrise (song)
The band released On the Border in 1974 , adding guitarist Don Felder as the fifth member midway through the recording of the album .	Don Felder	Don Felder	On the Border	On the Border

The album generated two top 40 singles : `` Already Gone '' and their first number one , `` Best of My Love . ''	top 40	top 40	Already Gone	Already Gone (Eagles song)	Best of My Love	Best of My Love (Eagles song)

Their 1975 album One of These Nights included three top 10 singles : `` One of These Nights , '' `` Lyin ' Eyes , '' and `` Take It to the Limit , '' the first hitting the top of the charts .	One of These Nights	One of These Nights (song)	Take It to the Limit	Take It to the Limit (Eagles song)
Guitarist and vocalist , Joe Walsh , also joined the band in 1975 .	Joe Walsh	Joe Walsh

The Eagles continued that success and hit their commercial peak in late 1976 with the release of Hotel California , which would go on to sell more than 16 million copies in the U.S. alone and more than 32 million copies worldwide .	California	California	Hotel California	Hotel California	Eagles	Eagles (album)
The album yielded two number-one singles , `` New Kid in Town '' and `` Hotel California . ''	California	California	Hotel California	Hotel California	New Kid in Town	New Kid in Town

They released their last studio album for nearly 28 years in 1979 with The Long Run , which spawned three top 10 singles : `` Heartache Tonight , '' `` The Long Run , '' and `` I Ca n't Tell You Why , '' the lead single being another chart-topping hit .	The Long Run	The Long Run (song)	Heartache Tonight	Heartache Tonight
The Eagles disbanded in July 1980 but reunited in 1994 for the album Hell Freezes Over , a mix of live and new studio tracks .	Eagles	Eagles (album)	Hell Freezes Over	Hell Freezes Over
They toured consistently and were inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 1998 .	Rock	Rock music	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame
In 2007 , the Eagles released Long Road Out of Eden , their first full studio album in 28 years and their sixth number one album .	Eagles	Eagles (album)	Long Road Out of Eden	Long Road Out of Eden
The next year they launched the Long Road Out of Eden Tour in support of the album .	Long Road Out of Eden Tour	Long Road Out of Eden Tour	Long Road Out of Eden	Long Road Out of Eden

In 2013 , they began the extended History of the Eagles Tour in conjunction with the band 's documentary release , History of the Eagles .	Eagles	Eagles (album)	History of the Eagles Tour	History of the Eagles – Live in Concert	History of the Eagles	History of the Eagles
Following the death of Frey in January 2016 , Henley stated in several interviews that he did n't think the band would perform again .
However , in March 2017 it was announced that the Eagles would be headlining two concerts in July 2017 .	Eagles	Eagles (album)
